m.d: Omar is a male given name.
If something is ominous, it relates to omens; it is significant.
If something is ominous, it gives an indication that something bad is about to happen; it is threatening.
m.e: The dark clouds moving into the area that we live in is an ominous sign that a bad storm is about to happen.

m.d: An omen is a warning or a sign about a good or bad event that will happen in the future; it is an augury or foreboding.
An omen is something of prophetic importance.
If you omen something, you predict its happening with an omen.
An omelette is a dish of beaten eggs cooked in oil, often with cheese and sometimes with other ingredients.
m.e: For breakfast, I had a three-egg ham and cheese omelette.
